prOriginal.nota: Taken from prOriginalConhecido; confirmed via gh pr view: MERGED 2025-02-12, merged as 679f44692d with the same single commit as the benchmark head 7355f05e6a.

add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.reason: PR #38322 ('Support partial evaluation for the group resource type', issue #38273, motivation 'Apply FGAP permissions when querying groups') moved V2 group filtering into the store query and wrapped the per-group canView filter in GroupResource.getSubGroups, GroupsResource.getGroups and GroupUtils.populateGroupHierarchyFromSubGroups with `if (!isAdminPermissionsEnabled(realm))`. Today's main still has that guard, so under FGAP V2 the listings no longer run one evaluation per group. The change was a functional rewrite to query-level filtering, not aimed at this perf cost; the canViewGlobal short-circuit itself was never restored (only the V1 path still filters per group).

astra.pergunta: Bug + benchmark code + #38322 diff + today's code; confirmado (fixed by #38322) or descontinuado (rewrite not aimed at this perf issue)?
astra.resposta: #38322 replaced the per-group V2 evaluation with query-level authorization; that removes the cost, but its stated motivation does not show it targeted this perf bug, so the behaviour disappeared through a rewrite; the remaining V1 filter does not change that.
